items.summary: For November 2026, we welcome Johannes Maron as our DSF member of the month! ⭐ Johannes has long been part of the Django community.
items.title: DSF member of the month - Johannes Maron

items.summary: We are pleased to announce that the 2026 Malcolm Tredinnick Memorial Prize has been awarded to Raffaella Suardini!
items.title: 2026 Malcolm Tredinnick Memorial Prize awarded to Raffaella Suardini

items.summary: The Django Software Foundation is inviting nominations for its 2027 Board of Directors. Five of the seven Board positions are open for election this year.
items.title: 2027 DSF Board Nominations

items.summary: In accordance with our security release policy, the Django team is issuing releases for Django 6.1.3, Django 6.0.10, and Django 5.2.19.
items.title: Django security releases issued: 6.1.3, 6.0.10, and 5.2.19

items.summary: After more than three years as a Django Fellow, I will be taking a three-month break from Fellow duties during November, December, and January.
items.title: Natalia Bidart - Planned short-term leave
